pairs.summary: BSX and ZNF35 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 7 of 14 profiles analysed (A549 lung adenocarcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; SW620 colorectal adenocarcinoma (metastasis); ...). Median lift 1.45x, typical spacing ~44 bp between sites. In 7 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.

BSX and MGA::EVX1 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 6 of 14 profiles analysed (K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; SW620 colorectal adenocarcinoma (metastasis); Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Endothelial (Exocrine Tissues); ...). Median lift 1.35x, typical spacing ~45 bp between sites. In 5 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: dimer motif, overlapping sites — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
